title: First Foo Fighter reports, November 1944

tellings.quote: anniversary of the first reports of Foo Fighters. Like that happened November of 1944.

plain: The first reports of foo fighters, the name airmen of the Second World War gave to strange lights seen near their planes, are said to date to November 1944. A guest on a debate episode, Marik von Rennenkampff, notes this in passing as an anniversary, saying "that happened November of 1944." It matters because it would put modern UFO reports in a line going back to the war.
